name: holographic-memory
description: Long-term local memory for Claude Code: a SQLite fact store with trust scoring and holographic recall, recalled before each turn, with memory tools over MCP. Runs from the plugin folder through uv; Claude Code only.

embedding_api_key.title: Embeddings API key (optional)
embedding_api_key.description: Only for search by meaning, which is off until you turn it on in config.toml: the key of the embeddings API named there (embedding_url). Leave it empty otherwise. Kept in your system's secure storage; the plugin reads no key from your environment or files.
